dedupe_keys.name: intelligent algorithm based modelling wastewater treatment

description: Experimental data from airlift and inverse-fluidised-bed bioreactors relate selenite loading and hydraulic retention to selenite and COD removal. The package supports comparisons of conventional and evolutionary training algorithms. This resource is provided by BISWANATH MAHANTY. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The two experimental systems are not representative of every wastewater-treatment process. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
